verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail advertises API integrations that connect the mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync. That is only a glancing nod toward event-driven automation: nothing in the evidence shows push notifications on new mail or scan completion, so polling may still be required. Missing for 10: documented webhooks for mail-arrival and scan-complete events, Zapier (or similar) triggers, event payload and API documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
